acceptance_criteria: Evidence records include immutable record ID, source_id, run_id, canonical URL, timestamps, artifact paths, SHA-256 hashes, normalized text hash, proof path, diff paths where available, source health, extraction quality, limitations, and legal-safe disclaimer.

Storage path is deterministic and separate from raw source snapshots.

tasks.blocker: No canonical evidence-record.json package exists yet; source snapshot proof.json is monitoring evidence only.

notes.note: Created after VARA activation exposed the distinction between source snapshot proof and canonical risk-brief evidence records.

Evidence Trail Phase 5 design: current VARA proof.json is BLOCK for customer risk briefs because it lacks schema_version, record_id, record_status, nested source/run/content/files/integrity/review blocks, canonical sha256: hashes, previous normalized artifact for non-FIRST_SEEN runs, and evidence-record.json.

Recommended storage: append-only evidence/{regulator_slug}/{source_id}/{run_id}/ with raw.html, snapshot.html, current.normalized.txt, previous.normalized.txt, metadata.json, and evidence-record.json. Do not migrate or rewrite source_snapshots; create derived backfill packages only when needed.

notes.note: Evidence Trail Phase 5 validator requirements: require canonical evidence-record.json; reject FAILED/QUALITY_DROP complete records; recompute current normalized SHA-256 with sha256: prefix; require previous normalized file/hash for non-FIRST_SEEN; require diff.txt for CHANGED only; require integrity.hash_verified=true, integrity_status=VERIFIED, verified_at, and review fields.
